weighted_method.representation: Explicit fully binary materialization of earlier verified original-map donors. Every donor substitution is a paid binary addition and every terminal expression is a signed wire alias.
weighted_method.adapter_source_representation_label: The adapter generic raw-source schema label describes its accepted JSON schema; the actual input banks in this campaign were explicitly materialized.
weighted_method.attribution_limit: The weighted stage consumed all earlier completed donor methods. Its ten lower donor counts are useful additions to those banks, but this sequential campaign is not a matched-input or matched-budget ablation and does not establish a general winner.

timing_interpretation: These are sums of sequential map or process wall durations across three concurrent workers, not campaign elapsed time. Donor-build totals contain the per-method elapsed times; weighted preparation, sampling, and solver times are nested inside the weighted-method duration and must not be added again. Other setup/export/verification is the remaining map duration. Sampling outside the weighted driver was not separately instrumented.
